reports.title: Claude Pro / Max / Team — session usage resets every five hours
reports.plan: Pro / Max (5x and 20x) / Team (Standard and Premium seats)
reports.model_or_feature: session usage across models and features (varies by length, files, conversation, model, and feature)
reports.published_allowance: Limits vary; not a fixed message count. Message count varies by length, files, conversation, model, and feature. Session-based usage limit resets every five hours. Pro: at least 5× Free per session at peak. Max 5x = 5× Pro per session; Max 20x = 20× Pro per session. Team Standard = 1.25× Pro per session; Team Premium = 6.25× Pro per session (Team multipliers from Team plan article, retrieved 2026-09-01).

official_source.title: What is the Pro plan? — Anthropic Help Center
official_source.quote: Your session-based usage limit will reset every five hours.

reports.source_display: Anthropic Help Center, Pro plan, retrieved 2026-09-03
reports.notes: OFFICIAL documentation row. One cap: the five-hour session window. Weekly assigned time is a separate row. Max plan article retrieved 2026-09-01 (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11049741-what-is-the-max-plan) repeats the same session sentence. Team plan article retrieved 2026-09-01 (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9266767-what-is-the-team-plan) describes usage per five-hour session with Standard 1.25× Pro and Premium 6.25× Pro; weekly language matches Pro/Max. Do not quote third-party prompt counts. Do not invent a message number. account_type is other because this row covers individual Pro/Max and Team seats together (same session clock).

reports.title: Claude Pro / Max / Team — weekly usage limit resets at an assigned time
reports.plan: Pro / Max (5x and 20x) / Team (Standard and Premium seats)
reports.model_or_feature: weekly usage limit that applies across all models
reports.published_allowance: Limits vary; not a fixed message count. A weekly usage limit applies across all models. The weekly limit resets at a fixed time each week assigned to the account. Reset day and time stay the same regardless of when you start using Claude or when the subscription begins. Full weekly allowance each cycle. Next reset time is in Settings > Usage. The assigned weekday/time is individualized — this row does not invent a wall clock.

official_source.title: What is the Pro plan? — Anthropic Help Center
official_source.quote: Pro plans also have a weekly usage limit that applies across all models. Weekly limits reset at a fixed time each week that is assigned to your account. Your reset day and time stay the same regardless of when you start using Claude or when your subscription begins, and you receive your full weekly allowance each cycle. You can see your next reset time in Settings > Usage.

reports.source_display: Anthropic Help Center, Pro plan, retrieved 2026-09-03
reports.notes: OFFICIAL documentation row. One cap: the weekly assigned-time limit. Five-hour session is a separate row. reset_kind is fixed (schema equivalent of assigned weekly): a fixed time each week, assigned per account, not a global weekday we can publish. Max plan article retrieved 2026-09-01 uses the same weekly assigned-time language (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11049741-what-is-the-max-plan). Team plan article retrieved 2026-09-01 matches the weekly assigned-time language for Standard and Premium seats (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9266767-what-is-the-team-plan). Do not quote third-party prompt counts or Sonnet-hour estimates.
reports.reset_fact: Weekly limit resets at a fixed time assigned to your account (Settings > Usage).

reports.title: GitHub Copilot (individuals) — included AI credits reset 00:00:00 UTC on the 1st
reports.model_or_feature: GitHub AI Credits (model-using features; code completions on paid plans are not billed in AI credits)
reports.published_allowance: Monthly GitHub AI Credits allowance that varies by plan (see official source for current amounts). Included credits do not carry over. Unused credits are forfeited. Allowance resets to the full monthly amount at 00:00:00 UTC on the first day of each calendar month, independent of the subscription billing date.

official_source.title: Usage-based billing for individuals — GitHub Docs
official_source.quote: Included AI credits do not carry over between months. Unused credits are forfeited, and your allowance resets to the full monthly amount at 00:00:00 UTC on the first day of each calendar month. This reset date is fixed and does not change based on your subscription billing date.

reports.source_display: GitHub Docs, usage-based billing for individuals, retrieved 2026-09-03
reports.notes: OFFICIAL documentation row from live fetch 2026-09-01. Clock is calendar-month UTC, not the GitHub billing-cycle start. Numeric credit tables on that page can change; this row records the reset clock, not a copied credit table. Business/Enterprise seats are out of scope for this individuals article.
reports.reset_fact: Included AI credits reset at 00:00:00 UTC on the 1st of each calendar month.

reports.title: Grok SuperGrok — shared weekly usage pool resets on a schedule in Settings
reports.model_or_feature: shared weekly usage pool across Chat, Imagine, Voice, Build, and API (compute-metered; not a fixed message count)
reports.published_allowance: One shared weekly usage pool across Grok products. Shown as a percentage, broken down by product. Different products cost different amounts of compute. The FAQ does not publish a numeric message count or a global weekday. Reset date and time are in Settings → Usage. Free-tier Chat and Voice limits are separate and reset on their own unpublished schedule — not a second public row.

official_source.title: FAQ - Grok Website / Apps — xAI Docs
official_source.quote: The usage pool limit resets every week on a schedule shown in the Usage tab in Settings.

reports.notes: OFFICIAL documentation row from live fetch 2026-09-03. SuperGrok weekly pool only. Do not invent a weekday, timezone, or message count. Do not file a free-tier row: the FAQ says those limits reset on their own schedule but does not publish the clock. Extra Usage Credits expire one year after purchase and are not a reset clock.
reports.reset_fact: Shared weekly usage pool resets every week on a schedule shown in Settings → Usage.
